component.name: PSF Guard
component.summary: Catalog, grade and plan N.I.N.A. astrophotography sessions

description.p: PSF Guard is a catalog, grader and quality-analysis tool for deep-sky astrophotography. Point it at folders of FITS or XISF frames, or open the Target Scheduler database that N.I.N.A. already keeps, and it lists every project and target with what has been captured, accepted and rejected.

Review frames quickly with star detection, PSF fitting, cloud and obstruction screening, and pixel-derived astrometry; compare frames side by side; grade them and write the grades back to Target Scheduler; and export the accepted lights, with their calibration frames, for stacking.

Plan the next session on the sky: frame a target or a mosaic over survey imagery or N.I.N.A.'s offline sky maps, see when it is up, and push the plan into each rig's database. Calibrated stacks and colour previews show how a project is coming along.

screenshot.caption: The Library: every project and target across your catalogs, with capture and grading progress
The image grid: frames with their star counts, HFR and quality scores, ready to grade
The Sky view: everything your catalogs have pointed at, on one map of the whole sky
